SUBSTANTIVE.verdict: PASS - recommend eligibility; root adjudication required
SUBSTANTIVE.details: Explicit open belief of a JMAA paper whose own method provably fails on (0,h^-1(1/2)] (H>0 on (0,inf)^3 shown in Remark 16(a)); (0,1) is load-bearing in the source's own Theorem 23 boundary classification. Same eligibility shape as accepted first-batch #23 (Simon threshold): exact source question + classical uncredited tool. All-c>1 is ONE family; c=2 is the source instance; no separate counting. Strongest objection: genericity of the weighted-Jensen mechanism / possible unpublished-or-unscreened abstract lemma; and the strict-evaluator parameter-range-extension reading, which this review rejects with reasons.

strongest_objection: The weighted-Jensen/perspective argument is a generic quasiconvexity mechanism; if any published abstract lemma covers level radii of sums of g((s+m)/x), the candidate collapses to a routine instantiation and the residual content reduces to convexity of one special-function boundary curve on (0,1). Bounded screen found no such lemma and the source's own failed-method statement shows standard digamma-convexity tools do not give it; residual risk is HOLD-level, not a refutation.
